mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) signals corporate investment acceleration and market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in GDP expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in federal funds rates below 1% triggers accommodative monetary policy, lowering borrowing costs and spurring equity market activity, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate does not remain below 1% for the required period, or the 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside expanding supply (INDPRO) signals economic growth, reducing uncertainty and driving up S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and INDPRO rises simultaneously
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO does not rise while the other does, or the combined effect does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 4.5% in a low-inflation environment reflects labor market adjustment, reducing wage pressures and boosting corporate profits, hence positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in a low-inflation regime
failure_condition: UNRATE does not sustain above 4.5% or inflation remains high, negating the labor market adjustment effect.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the CPIAUCSL below 2% signals deflationary pressures, lowering real interest rates and stimulating equity demand, resulting in positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not remain below 2% for the required period, or the 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 4.5% in a low-inflation context signals labor market improvement, reducing wage inflation and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not stay above 4.5% for the 5-day horizon, or returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment (PAYEMS) alongside rising GDP demand (GDPC1) indicates labor market tightening and economic expansion, reducing uncertainty and driving up S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and PAYEMS rises simultaneously
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or PAYEMS does not rise while the other does, or the combined effect does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO signals improving supply conditions, reducing production costs and enhancing corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO plateaus or declines despite expectations, or the 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
